news.title: Purdue MEM students join Ugandan social enterprise to chart path for sustainable growth
news.summary_en: Graduate students in Purdue University's Master of Engineering Management (MEM) program are joining a Ugandan social enterprise to strengthen its ability to deliver clean water to underserved communities while building a foundation for long-term growth.

news.title: Purdue MEM students team with Kenyan agritech startup to strengthen food security through business innovation
news.summary_en: Graduate students in Purdue University’s Master of Engineering Management (MEM) program are partnering with a Kenyan startup to expand its impact on smallholder farmers by developing strategies to support long-term growth and improve food security.

news.title: Purdue expands semiconductor professional education portfolio to advance global workforce development
news.summary_en: Purdue University is expanding its semiconductor professional education by collaborating with National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU) in Taiwan to deliver the Semiconductor Academy.

news.title: BME's Miller designs experiences to help students gain real-world skills in Indianapolis
news.summary_en: For Sharon Miller, being an educator isn’t just about passing on technical knowledge — it’s about giving students the tools to recognize their strengths and gain confidence in settings that help turn theory into practice.
